custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior texture of the meatloaf. AI generators often struggle with the specific granular look of cooked ground meat, sometimes replacing it with uniform noise or smearing. Also, check if the glaze looks like a liquid sitting on top or if it merges unnaturally with the meat crust.
